change.ordered_execution: A Draw run may split at a target-layout change only when the old and new Xenos color/depth tile footprints are disjoint. Each segment is submitted in PM4 order and retained in its exact-layout GPU CachedEdramTarget.
change.no_copy_segment: Stores its cached color/depth attachments and transitions cached color to shader-read layout for later queue-ordered use. It does not render to or transition the presenter image.
change.fail_closed: Invalid address layouts and overlapping EDRAM aliases remain rejected. No address-based color/sample conversion or shared physical EDRAM buffer was added.

regression.shape: Draw(layout A), Draw(layout B), Copy/Convert; layout A and B use disjoint Xenos color and depth tile footprints.
checks: both exact-layout targets remain in the Vulkan resource cache
ordered final Copy/Convert readback equals direct submission of layout B
regression.classification: synthetic executor and cache regression; not retail graphics parity

android_arm64_api26.device_execution: not run; adb devices -l returned no connected devices

remaining_blockers: The retail 14-draw transition aliases color EDRAM across different extents, sample counts, and formats; that overlapping path still requires a shared physical backing store and sample/format transfer.
Xenos clear effects and depth/stencil persistence across aliased layouts are not implemented.
This change has not been replayed against a retail capture and makes no retail pixel-parity claim.
The source-1 interrupt packet-to-callback audit remains timestamp/order correlation; exact callback payload semantics are still open.
